title: Effect of selectively introducing arginine and D-amino acids on the antimicrobial activity and salt sensitivity in analogs of human beta-defensins.

materials_exhausted.notes: OA package had no archive members; supplementary .bin assets were local PLOS/HTML pages and did not add structured activity/toxicity/mechanism tables. XML/PDF text and linked database JSONL were sufficient for worker-2/4/6 adjudication.

summary: Source-reviewed worker-2/4/6 re-review extracted the Table 2 LC/MFC matrix, reconciled linked DBAASP rows, preserved CAMP/dbAMP conflicts, and re-adjudicated final outputs with cautions.
adjudication_summary: Publication-grade acceptance is limited to obtainable local evidence: 18 source-supported activity rows, conflict-preserving database statuses, and qualitative mechanism claims from microscopy/figure captions/discussion.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP assay/literature rows that match Table 1 and Table 2 are source_verified; CAMP/dbAMP mixed, broad, or unsupported rows are retained as source_conflict/database_only_no_primary_source cautions.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Table 2 was manually parsed into LC/MFC rows with endpoint, raw value, unit, target, strains where reported, assay conditions, replicate/statistics context, and locators; P. aeruginosa Phd-1/Phd-3 cells are explicitly not determined.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism claims are qualitative and source-located to confocal microscopy captions/results/discussion; no unsupported exact figure values were invented.

caution_findings.evidence_context: CAMP/dbAMP rows contain broad peptide aliases, multi-publication annotations, or unsupported MBC µg/ml/database-only activity classes; these remain source_conflict/database_only_no_primary_source.
Phd-1 and Phd-3 Table 2 rows are primary-table reported but footnoted as values from reference [23].
Figure 1/2 salt/cation effects are preserved qualitatively from local text/captions; exact bar values were not needed for gate repair and were not fabricated.
